label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 10 items closed on 7 Oct, including the buyer returns and refunds story (MT-1331, three weeks late), the cart and checkout pricing tests (MT-1543), the stored-credits and ACH refund designs (MT-1409, MT-1410) and six AI-server catalogue fixes (PC-149 to PC-154). Work started on the live chat widget (MT-1577, due 14 Oct), security testing (MT-1547) and the RMA backend. 21 items are past due, but 20 of them have not been touched in 30 days, including MT-1053 and MT-992 (due 31 Aug, still in UAT).

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Two chatbot and page bugs were fixed on 7 Oct (MR-1297, MR-1310), and a cross-browser testing bug (MR-1317) was raised with six page subtasks. Open bugs are 19, none rated. The sitemap fix (MR-1199), MR-1168 and the Figma fixes are still Ready for Prod and not released; related products content (MR-1265) is still blocked. 6 items are past due, five of them June tasks in 'In Prod1'. 75 tickets sat in a sprint that has ended.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Two of the three S1 production bugs were fixed on 7 Oct: the final price mismatches on the AI Factory pages (USP-4229, USP-4230). The Document API 502 (USP-4231) is still open. Four add-server form bugs and two data tasks were raised. 97 items are past due: 31 active ones and 66 nobody has touched in 30 days, 39 of those held by Livian Stefan Stan and Ankit Saxena. The Sept 2nd Sprint ended on 29 Sep and is still open with 20 tickets.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: No changes on 7 Oct. Marketplace sign-in for the chatbot (UC-225) is in progress, due 15 Oct; admin analytics (UC-25) and model selection (UC-26), due the same day, have not started. 24 design and specification tasks held by Ankit Saxena have been past due since August and untouched since 13 Aug. UC-8 Public Chatbots is at 21 of 54 tasks, due 18 Oct.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: One subtask was added on 7 Oct (PULSE-330, production endpoint and DNS checks, unassigned). One item is done (PULSE-329); the other 329 are held by Anshul Bhargava and none has a due date.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: A third item was added on 7 Oct: a POC understanding meeting (ATLAS-3) for Saurabh Jain. ATLAS-1 (Anshul Bhargava) and the MVP scope task (ATLAS-2) are still in To Do, and none of the three has a due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: Five field-validation styling bugs were closed on 7 Oct (ID-696 to ID-699, ID-710); 31 items closed in 30 days. The 6 past-due items are the claims-removal tasks due 15 Sep (ID-679 to ID-684): all in production, but not closed. 15 tickets have no assignee and 11 missed the September sprints. The work depends on Azure AD B2C and Rafay (ID-745, ID-746, ID-747).

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 7 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156, due 15 Jul) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: One Key Vault configuration subtask was raised and closed on 7 Oct (IN-1147). 23 items are past due, 16 of them untouched in 30 days. 15 sit in BLOCKER status, 11 of them held by k.kishore: Azure Virtual Desktop and licensing (IN-990, IN-994 to IN-999), the Jira and Azure DevOps integration (IN-992, IN-1005 to IN-1007) and APIM WebSocket routing (IN-776 to IN-778, due 27 Mar). The S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: One marketplace issue was closed on 7 Oct (DM-1083). 27 items are past due, 25 of them untouched in 30 days, 17 of those waiting in review; the oldest date is July 2025. The two active ones are the soft 404 fix (DM-1074) and the missing H1 tags (DM-1077). The design team's own timelines are covered under Dependencies.
